text.p: CSX Corp said it expects three percent growth in 1997 revenues in its CSX Transportation business, adding $140 million to $145 million.
CSX said it expects to bring between 80 and 84 percent of the revenue growth to the bottom line.
The company earlier reported fourth quarter earnings of $1.17 a share compared with $1.31 last year including a gain. Analysts had expected earnings of about $1.14 a share, according to First Call.
The 1995 fourth quarter earnings included an investment gain of $0.24 per share.

Paul Goodwin, the company's chief financial officer, said at an earnings presentation that the company's earnings improvement, excluding the year-earlier gain, was largely driven by a focus on costs, since revenues for the fourth quarter declined slightly.
